notes.title: New Update Demo April 2024
notes.content:
For quite some time we were working on a new update, with new content and improvements
Currently we are still working, however we have to say with great sadness that the game is delayed until 2025, we feel that we are very far from what we want to offer you, so we have decided to take a little more time to bring a better game to compensate the waiting we have brought you an update with a lot of additional content

Stay with Me! Alien abduction Story, is a psychological horror game that immerses us in the story of Ana and her daughter who disappeared under strange circumstances. The entire gameplay runs under the camera in Mano where Ana films for some strange reason her last hours before to disappear. Although something strange happens with the recordings of it, every time the tape reaches an end it rewinds presenting new content that was not there before, can you endure the entire experience until you discover the true ending?

Update Note:
* Fixed a bug that occurred when parsing objects
* We can now see Ana's Hand or her daughter when analyzing objects
* Subtitles were added to the Bonus Video
* A Bug that prevented returning to the Main Menu when entering the Bonus Video was corrected
* Some in-game references changed
* You can now select the language at the start of the game, just before entering the Main Menu
* Some Splash texts are affected by VHS post processing
* In the cabin after talking on the phone you had to pick up the camera, now the same but it does it automatically, you don't need to press a button, you just get closer and that's it.
* Now every time you finish a game ending, subliminal messages will always appear on the Main Menu TV encouraging you to play again
* When we return to the Main Menu, from the Menu Pause, the Main Menu TV will ask us if we are afraid to continue, if we continue playing at the beginning a couple of Jumpscares will appear as punishment for wanting to abandon the game
* Based on the above, if you continue playing after finishing an ending, the game offers you different facts from how things happen previously, we will not always have to do the same thing to advance to the beginning.
* Some audio and subtitles were corrected
* Now the girl, Ana's daughter, has more participation in the game
* Some scenes can now be skipped, such as when the VHS is inserted and removed from the player, as well as other scenes where the narrator speaks
* Added some environment improvements
* Some 3D models of Ana's house were changed, to give it a little more ruese to the game, however it is taking a long time to do so since the game has a lot of text, we hope to be able to publish this update during May 2024ealism
* A decorative wall clock was added to the house, however it shows the exact time, that is, the time on it changes.
* Now there are some differences in the endings, this is intended to present a more horror experience.
* A new Puzzle was added in relation to the action of cutting the chain of the forest gate, we need, as before, to pick up the saw, and after that go to cut it, then the Puzzle begins there


Additional Note:
* We are currently also working to add Portuguese to the demo, but due to time we were not able to release it yet, it is possible that in May of this year, it will be available
